message.reasoning:
We have a Monopoly game. Player p1 (Alpha) has cash 64, owes 1670 rent to p2 (Beta). Shortfall 1650. Must liquidate assets: can mortgage properties (electric company, water works, Pennsylvania RR, B&O RR) - but those are not owned? Wait holdings: owned list includes only reading railroad (mortgaged), and several orange and red properties with houses. No utilities or other railroads. So mortgageable_space_keys list includes properties that are owned? But they are not owned, so cannot mortgage. So only sellable_building_space_keys: includes the orange and red monopolies (with houses) and also PARK_PLACE, BOARDWALK (but not owned). So can sell houses/hotels from those properties. Each house sale gives cash equal to building cost? In Monopoly, selling house returns half purchase price. Need to know building costs: For each color group, house cost: For orange (St. James Place, Tennessee Avenue, New York Avenue) house cost is $100 each. For red (Kentucky, Indiana, Illinois) house cost is $150 each. For Park Place and Boardwalk, house cost is $200 each (but not owned). So we can sell houses from those properties. Each property currently has 3 houses (no hotel). So total houses: 6 properties * 3 = 18 houses. Selling each yields half cost: orange houses $50 each, red houses $75 each. So total cash from selling all orange houses: 3 properties * 3 houses =9 houses * $50 = $450. Red houses: 9 houses * $75 = $675. Total from selling all houses = $1125. Also we could mortgage reading railroad (already mortgaged) can't. Could mortgage other railroads if owned, not. Could mortgage utilities not owned. So after selling all houses, cash becomes 64 + 1125 = 1189. Still short of 1670 (shortfall 481). Could also sell houses from Park Place/Boardwalk if owned, not. Could sell houses from other properties? None. Could also sell houses and then mortgage? After selling houses, we could mortgage properties we own: we own reading railroad (mortgaged already), and the orange/red properties (but they are not mortgaged). Could mortgage them after selling houses (must have no houses). Mortgage value: For each property, mortgage value is half purchase price. Purchase prices: St. James Place $180, Tennessee $180, New York $200, Kentucky $220, Indiana $220, Illinois $240. Mortgage values: $90, $90, $100, $110, $110, $120 respectively. So total mortgage cash if we mortgage all six: sum = 90+90+100+110+110+120 = $620. After selling houses we have 1189 cash, then mortgage all six gives +620 = 1809, enough to pay 1670. But we need to choose exactly one liquidation action now. The engine will apply it, then ask again if still cannot pay. So we must pick one action: either mortgage a property, or sell houses/hotel (multiple at once?), or declare bankruptcy. The sell_houses_or_hotel action allows specifying a list of sell plans. We can sell multiple houses in one action. So we could sell all houses (18) in one action, raising $1125, still short. Then engine will ask again, we can then mortgage. So we need to decide best sequence. Could also sell some houses and mortgage one property now to get enough cash in one step? The rule: choose exactly one liquidation action now. So we could sell houses and also mortgage? No, only one action. So we need to pick an action that will bring cash enough? If we sell all houses and also mortgage one property in same action not allowed. So we must either sell houses (maybe all) then next step mortgage. Or mortgage first (maybe one property) then still short, then next step sell houses. Which is better? Probably sell houses first because we need to free up properties for mortgage later (must have no houses). So sell all houses now. That yields cash 1125, still short 545? Wait owed 1670, cash 64, after selling houses cash = 64+1125=1189, short 481. Then next step we can mortgage properties. So we choose sell_houses_or_hotel with all houses.

We need to construct sell_plan list: each entry includes space_key, kind "HOUSE", count. For each property we have 3 houses. So list of 6 entries each count 3.

Let's produce public_message maybe "Selling houses to raise cash." Private thought: reasoning.

Now call function sell_houses_or_hotel.
